requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied painting is the approved opening scene for a creation game. Extract and REPAINT ONLY its small rocky planet as a clean separate illustration on a genuinely transparent background. The surrounding nebula is style and lighting reference, not part of the output. This is the INITIAL WORLD, before the catastrophic Moon-forming impact: a spherical, mostly dark charcoal and warm iron-brown rocky world, with modest fine dull-red fissures and occasional deep ember seams, no broad orange molten patches. Rough closely distributed irregular rock texture at a fine scale, simplified painted gouache rather than photographic relief. Recognizable solid ball, regular round outline, subtle warm illumination from upper left, not a lumpy asteroid. No modern continents, oceans, atmosphere, large mountains, visible craters or gas-planet stripes. Keep the luminous energetic painted language of the supplied image, but the ball is much cooler and darker than the current red-hot ball. The entire ball should be centered on a square transparent canvas, about 72 percent of its width, with clean edge and ample empty transparent padding. No surrounding glow, haze, outline, axis line, orbit, ring, moon, stars, debris, text or diagram symbols. ONE planet only. This will be used quite small against the dark void, so retain readable warm slate and iron-brown facets rather than making the whole ball black.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the POST-IMPACT state of the single young rocky planet shown in the first supplied reference (transparent initial planet); the second reference is the surrounding nebula painting, supplied ONLY for palette and painted style. Output one separate distorted molten planet on a genuinely transparent square canvas. The catastrophic impact that forms its Moon has just remelted it. Make its silhouette unmistakably oblate and asymmetrical: a broad squashed rocky oval about 1.5 times as wide as high, its long axis tilted 15 degrees clockwise, with an uneven bulging lower-right side and slightly depressed upper-left shoulder. Still one heavy coherent planetary mass, not an asteroid cloud or a comet. Its whole surface is now a fine broken charcoal-black raft mosaic interspersed with vivid red-orange molten seams and many small bright orange/yellow pools; fairly evenly distributed fine irregular patches rather than huge sweeping bands or continents. Much hotter and more unsettled than the first reference, visually related to the small red-hot planet in the second reference. Hand-painted energetic gouache, crisp mass and brush-textured rock, not an infographic or technical simulation. Center it with ample transparent padding, silhouette about 76 percent of canvas width. Strong three-dimensional volume, recognizable sphere deformed by a tremendous blow. Do NOT paint the moon or impacting asteroid; those are separate game icons. No flying debris, rings, atmosphere, glow outside the silhouette, orbit, axis, diagram marks, nebula clouds, background, stars, lettering or frame. The scene compositor will place it off-center partially behind existing clouds; draw the complete distorted planet here, without any clouds or cropping.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Turn the supplied distorted post-impact molten planet into its STEADIED WORLD state for the same illustrated creation game. Keep exactly the same charcoal and iron-brown fine rocky surface material, small irregular orange-red molten fissures and yellow-hot pools, painted energetic gouache texture and warm lighting. Change the overall shape into one regular, convincingly spherical ball with a clean circular outline, no lumps or bulges. Distribute the fine molten seams across its surface, without large swirling bands or continent-shaped features. It remains very hot, awaiting cooling in the following chapter; do not add blue oceans, atmosphere, continents, clouds, life, large mountains or crater patterns. Center the sphere on a square genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas, ball about 72 percent of canvas width with empty padding. Absolutely no spin axis, little axis loop, orbit, ring, diagram line, moon, stars, nebula, external halo, glow outside its crisp silhouette, debris, background, text or frame. One centered spherical molten world only. The spherical ball will be registered back at the center of the void in the game.
